papers.title: Nexus: Depth-Adaptive KV-Cache Splicing and Retrieval-Decoupled Tool Routing for Agentic LLMs on Unified Memory
papers.innovation: Proposes KV-cache splicing and a novel retrieval-decoupled tool routing mechanism to reduce the quadratic prefill cost associated with large tool registries in agentic LLMs. This directly addresses the performance bottleneck of Time-To-First-Token (TTFT).
papers.benchmarks: Focuses on optimizing TTFT, reducing computational cost associated with tool schema prefill, and improving memory efficiency for agentic LLM inference.
papers.use_case: Deploying and scaling agentic LLMs that need to interact with a growing number of tools, ensuring fast response times and efficient resource utilization in production environments.

papers.title: PrimeAgentOrchestrator: Memory-Primed Agent Spawning for Personal AI Infrastructure
papers.innovation: Introduces a system that "memory-primes" new instances of LLM agents by pre-loading them with relevant accumulated knowledge from prior work, overcoming the limitation of agents starting each session with an empty context.
papers.benchmarks: Improved agent efficiency, reduced redundancy in tasks, and enhanced continuity of work by leveraging previously acquired knowledge.
papers.use_case: Developing persistent and intelligent personal or team-based AI assistants and coding agents that learn and remember across sessions, leading to more productive and context-aware interactions.

papers.title: Representation Affects Retrieval: A Case Study of Skill Discovery and Routing in a Multimodal Agent Harness
papers.innovation: Investigates the critical problem of skill discovery and routing in production agent harnesses, demonstrating how the representation of skills impacts an agent's ability to select the most appropriate tool for a given task, moving beyond simple in-context selection.
papers.benchmarks: Performance metrics related to accuracy and efficiency of skill selection/ranking, and overall effectiveness of agent tool use.
papers.use_case: Designing and optimizing the architecture for how AI agents dynamically discover, select, and utilize relevant tools or skills from an expanding library, crucial for building versatile and capable agentic systems.
